title: Underground Mining Operations Risk Assessment
description: Free Underground Mining Operations Risk Assessment template for mining you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers hazards and controls, pre-shift checks, approval & sign-off.

Risk Rating Guide (L = Likelihood 1-5, S = Severity 1-5, Risk = L X S)

1. 1-4 Low: manage by routine procedures.

2. 5-9 Medium: add controls where reasonably practicable and monitor.

3. 10-16 High: do not start or continue until controls reduce the risk; senior approval

needed.

4. 17-25 Extreme: stop work; redesign or eliminate the hazard.

Pre-Shift Checks

☐ Workplace examination by a competent person completed

☐ Atmosphere tested; ventilation operating

☐ Ground conditions checked and supported

☐ Communication and tracking system working

☐ Self-rescuers and personal gas detectors issued
